description: This file defines schemas and validation logic for booking responses, including preprocessing and validation functions for different field types, and schema generation functions for partial and full booking response schemas.

methods.name: preprocessField
methods.description: Processes a single booking response field based on its type, including JSON parsing, boolean conversion, and phone number validation.

methods.name: superRefineField
methods.description: Performs validation on a booking response field based on its type, including email, phone, multiselect, and custom validation logic.

methods.name: doesEmailMatchEntry
methods.description: Checks if a given email matches an email/domain entry, supporting exact email, domain with '@', and domain without '@'.

methods.name: getBookingResponsesPartialSchema
methods.description: Generates a partial schema for booking responses, used when not all responses are required.

methods.name: getBookingResponsesSchema
methods.description: Generates a full schema for booking responses.

methods.name: getBookingResponsesSchemaWithOptionalChecks
methods.description: Generates a schema for booking responses with optional field validation.

methods.name: preprocess
methods.description: Preprocesses and validates booking response data according to the schema, handling partial schemas and validation errors.
